title: Is Zillow Accurate?
description:
Is Zillow Accurate? 🤔

Trusting Zillow to value your home is just like marrying someone based on their friends. Zillow's algorithm uses public data and has never seen your home's unique features, upgrades, or its true value.
If you want a true, accurate value for your home, call a professional. I’m here to help you every step of the way with a custom market proposal. I live, work, and breathe real estate full-time. Let’s get you the right value, not just a Zestimate! 🏡💼
